Full-Stack Software Engineer (Remote)
Company: BuildKit is a remote-first Indian SaaS startup (registered in Bengaluru, Karnataka; distributed team across India) building developer tooling for cloud-native application teams, backed by a Tier 1 Indian and a US-based VC fund.

Location: Fully Remote (India only; IST working hours with async-first culture)
Compensation: INR 20-32 LPA + ESOPs

About the Role:
We are a 25-person, fully distributed team and we work GitHub-first: every decision, design, and discussion is documented asynchronously before synchronous discussion. We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer who thrives in this environment, can own features end-to-end with minimal supervision, and communicates clearly in writing.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement features across our React (TypeScript) frontend and Node.js/Go backend services
- Own features from technical design through deployment and post-launch monitoring
- Write thorough pull requests with clear context, rationale, and testing notes - we value async communication
- Collaborate with product and design via GitHub Issues, Notion, and Loom rather than defaulting to meetings
- Participate in lightweight code review culture: thorough, kind, and fast
- Contribute to internal runbooks and documentation to support team-wide knowledge sharing

Requirements:
- 3+ years of full-stack engineering experience (required)
- Strong proficiency with React and TypeScript on the frontend (required)
- Backend experience in Node.js or Go (required)
- Comfortable with GitHub-first, async communication workflows (required)
- Experience deploying to AWS or GCP using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CDK) (required)
- Self-motivated with strong written English communication skills (required)

Nice to have:
- Prior experience at a remote-first or distributed company
- Familiarity with developer tooling products (CI/CD, observability, IaC)
- Experience with PostgreSQL and data modeling for SaaS multi-tenancy
- Contributions to open-source projects (especially tools your team uses)
- Interest in distributed systems and cloud-native architecture
